name: net.envoyant/agentic
title: Envoyant
description: Automated endpoint for Envoyant. Returns only answers Envoyant approved.

tools.name: ask_question
tools.description: Answers questions about Envoyant with answers Envoyant approved. Returns a text approved by Envoyant, unchanged; nothing is generated. Do not include personal details.

answerId.description: Optional. The answerId (a UUID) of one of the suggestedQuestions of an earlier result, to get that answer.

language.description: Optional. BCP 47 language of the question, e.g. "en" or "nl".

tools.name: get_business_info
tools.description: Returns business information approved by Envoyant: contact details, address and opening hours.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Sends a quote request to Envoyant, which replies directly. Use only with the user's explicit agreement.

contactConsent.description: Set to true only after the user has explicitly agreed to share these details with this business so that it can contact them.
